profile.headline: Software Developer (Full-Stack) @ LineLeader | M.S. Computer Science, Rice University
profile.summary:
I'm currently a Master of Computer Science at Rice University, specializing in Artificial Intelligence. I also have a strong background in full stack web development from my previous professional experiences.

Reading news, watching sports and playing chess are my favorite hobbies.

positions.title: Software Developer (Full-Stack)
positions.description:
Developed and shipped full-stack features spanning Vue.js/TypeScript and Symfony/PHP

Integrated Twilio-powered SMS and call tracking into core product workflows

Optimized backend performance and strengthened API reliability

Expanded automated test coverage across Jest, Cypress, and PHPUnit

positions.title: Junior Software Developer (Frontend)
positions.description:
Contributed to Vue.js migration from legacy codebase, rewriting components and improving frontend maintainability

Developed UI features and resolved frontend bugs across product initiatives

Built and styled responsive components in alignment with design specs

Collaborated in agile sprints with product, design, and QA teams

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description:
•	Resolve technology problems or concerns encountered by students, instructors or staff members
•	Troubleshoot the operation of computers and other lab’s equipment such as projectors, routers, and Oculus VR
•	Provide help and assistance for students or faculty members with any new software or hardware updates
•	Perform weekly inspection and maintenance of the audiovisual automation system in every classroom

company.name: Texas Christian University - M.J. Neeley School of Business

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed new functionality for a webpage to assist high school students and counselors in college preparation
•	Optimized performance and improved user experience by deferring the load of unnecessary JavaScript functions
•	Configured and integrated MySQL database with the server-side by utilizing PHP scripting language
•	Fixed existing bugs and enhanced features based on recent clients’ feedback
